mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Missile Barrage Ammo @Stack@</titleLeft><mainText>Corki can use his Missile Barrage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Gatling Gun (@Stack@)</titleLeft><mainText>This unit's Armor and Magic Resist are reduced.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Valkyrie</titleLeft><mainText>Corki takes to the sky, leaving a trail of destruction in his wake.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>The Big One</titleLeft><mainText>Corki has loaded a more powerful missile for his next Missile Barrage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

Hextech MunitionsHextech Shrapnel Shells
@f4*100@% of Corki's basic attack damage is converted into magic damage.

The Package
After an initial @f3@ minutes, The Package arrives near the fountain. Once picked up, The Package lasts for up to 60 seconds, granting @f2@% out of combat Move Speed and upgrading Valkyrie into Special Delivery.

The Package reloads @f1@ minutes after being dropped off by Corki.

mLocKeys.keySummary: A percentage of Corki's basic attack damage is dealt as bonus <trueDamage>true damage</trueDamage>.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Corki's Attacks and Spellblades deal @AttackConversion*100@% bonus true damage.
Attacks: @BasicAttackTOOLTIP@.
Critical Strikes: @CriticalStrikeTOOLTIP@.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Missiles Fired @Stack@</titleLeft><mainText>Corki is building toward a Big One.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Corki flies a short distance, dropping bombs that create a trail of fire that damages opponents who remain in it.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Corki flies over and scorches a path, burning it for @TrailDuration@ seconds. Enemies in the fire take up to <magicDamage>@MaximumDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> over the duration.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Corki's gatling gun rapidly fires in a cone in front of him, dealing damage and reducing enemy Armor and Magic Resist.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Corki fires a gatling gun in front of him, dealing <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> over @SprayDuration@ seconds and shredding up to <scaleArmor>@ShredMax*-1@ Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR>.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>The shred lingers for @ShredDuration@ seconds after being hit.</rules>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Corki fires a missile toward his target location that explodes on impact, dealing damage to enemies in an area. Corki stores missiles over time, up to a maximum. Every 3rd missile fired will be a Big One, dealing extra damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Corki fires a missile that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing @RSmallMissileDamage@ physical damage to surrounding enemies. Every third missile instead deals @RBigMissileDamage@ physical damage.

This Ability has up to @MaxAmmoTOOLTIP@ charges. Basic attacks against champions reduce the time between charges by @AttackRefund@ seconds on hit.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Corki fires a flash bomb at a target location, dealing magic damage to enemies in the area. This attack additionally reveals units in the area for a duration.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Corki lobs a bomb, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>. The area and champions hit are revealed for @RevealDuration@ seconds.
